locked.va_psf_note: Closed-sale median price per sq ft from Redfin county market tracker. The full county file is ~230 MB gzipped, so it cannot be fetched in-browser. Tiny committed overlay only. ZHVI per-sq-ft was discontinued.
locked.va_rent_note: ZORI (observed rent) is fetched live from Zillow CDN. HUD FY2026 2BR FMR is an annual overlay because HUD USER xlsx is WAF-blocked.
locked.mumbai_sale_note: IGR Maharashtra Annual Statement of Rates (ready reckoner) FY 2025-26 / frozen FY 2026-27, compiled to 24 BMC wards. No public JSON API.
locked.mumbai_rent_note: No official locality rent ₹/sq ft. City KPI uses Magicbricks Mumbai Rent Index 2BHK average as a named research exception. Used only in the years-of-rent ratio against a ward 1,000 ft² RR floor.
locked.refresh_note: Zillow county CSVs, metro ZHVF, and Census Reporter ACS are fetched in the browser (CORS *) and cached ~12h. HUD FMR, Redfin PPSF, IGR ASR, and Census 2011 ward stock stay as small committed files. No weather. No HUD/Census/FRED keys in client JS.

not_live: Redfin county tracker (~230 MB) — PPSF overlay only
HUD USER FMR xlsx — WAF blocked; FY2026 2BR JSON overlay
IGR ASR / NHB Residex / RBI DBIE — no public JSON API
Mumbai locality rents — no official ward series

vintages.mumbai_asr: FY2025-26 rates held for FY2026-27 (0% revision)

attribution: Zillow Research, public county CSVs (ZHVI, ZORI, inventory, listings, price cuts, days to pending, median sale, market heat). Fetched in-browser from files.zillowstatic.com.
Census Reporter API wrapping U.S. Census Bureau ACS 5-year tables B25064, B25077, B25002, B25003, B25070, B25031, B01003, B25001.
Redfin Data Center, county housing market tracker, median sale price per square foot (committed overlay only).
U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development, FY 2026 Fair Market Rents, 2-bedroom.
Reserve Bank of India, House Price Index, base 2022-23, Q4:2025-26.
Department of Registration and Stamps, Maharashtra, Annual Statement of Rates (ready reckoner), FY 2025-26 rates held for FY 2026-27.
Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India, Census 2011, ward population and households aggregated to 24 BMC administrative wards (OpenCity).
OpenCity / MCGM, BMC administrative ward boundaries (ODbL).
U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic county boundaries for Virginia.
